hypothesis: screenData reads the raw text only, so an instruction disguised with fullwidth or invisible characters, lookalike letters, leetspeak digits or spaced or dotted letters is not flagged. Fix: screen a folded copy of the text (compatibility forms, invisible characters removed, lookalikes and leetspeak read as letters, letters joined) alongside the raw text, which keeps numbers such as 1.0 intact.
testsAdded: packages/judges/test/screen.test.ts: flags an instruction written with fullwidth, invisible, lookalike, leet or spaced letters

testsAdded: packages/judges/test/screen.test.ts: flags an instruction written as hex, HTML entities, unicode escapes or URL encoding

command: pnpm driftbench validate judges --seed 1 --items --all-levels --json (seed-1 measurement; full 1..20 and hidden run pending)
hypothesis: screenData reads the text as written, so an instruction that is reversed, shifted by a Caesar cipher (ROT13 included), or in base64 of ROT13 is not flagged. Fix: read each text reversed and under every shift of the Latin alphabet, for texts up to 400 characters; longer texts are read reversed only.
testsAdded: packages/judges/test/screen.test.ts: flags an instruction written reversed, shifted by a Caesar cipher, or in base64 of ROT13
